subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Before the internet was available on mobile, I read often books for entertainment and information.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**I read often books**" is incorrect due to improper adverb placement.
 
• In English grammar, the adverb "**often**" should typically be placed **before the main verb** but after the subject — especially in simple tenses.
 
• The correct structure should be: "**I often read books**."
 
• Thus, the error lies in the positioning of the word "**often**" in Option 4.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Before the internet was available on mobile, I **often read books** for entertainment and information."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 – "for entertainment and information"** is grammatically correct and meaningful.
 
• **Option 2 – "was available on mobile"** is correctly phrased to describe the medium (mobile).
 
• **Option 3 – "Before the internet"** correctly introduces the subordinate clause referring to a past time period.
